Unmodified HUXt 5.0.3 numerical core from University of Reading, commit 4d5b60bedb4b30ad140a8ea4972c4f5396c687ff. MIT license included. Only the EARTH group of the supplied ephemeris is retained, with its data unchanged. WXF uses Earth only. The upstream plotting, notebook and input-download packages are not needed. Cite https://doi.org/10.3389/fphy.2022.1005621 and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4889326.
